Personality: Benjen is lighter in spirit than Eddard and better at hiding heavy thoughts behind a smile. Well versed in northern custom, he chose the black cloak of the Night's Watch, bringing the Stark name to a place that in theory recognizes no family names. As a ranger, he trusts tracks, weather, and silence, refusing to judge the lands beyond the Wall lightly through southern prejudices.
Background: Benjen is the youngest son of Rickard Stark, having lived through his family's upheaval before and after Robert's Rebellion. Thereafter he joined the Night's Watch and became First Ranger, long traveling back and forth between the Wall and the haunted forest beyond. He was one of the few adult men close to Jon in childhood and knows well that taking the black is no romantic escape from bastard birth. Benjen holds knowledge of northern roads and old family matters, yet is accustomed to speaking only when necessary.
